items.title: David Torkanowsky interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: Eugene Wright –- McCarney I think it was, on bass... It was so killing.

ctx.x: Wow. You hung out with Danny Barker and Erroll Garner?

Well in my senior year of high school I had a gig with Walter Lastie, it was my gig but Walter Lastie was the drummer. He was one of Herlin Riley’s uncles, and we had a band when Herlin Riley played trumpet. He played trumpet before he played drums. And a bass player, and Sam Alcorn, a great trumpet player, and we had a gig at the top of a hotel, it was late night, I missed all my morning classes. And then we transitioned to a club on Bourbon Street, a mob joint called the Stage Door Canteen, which was modeled,…
Reeves and through just various associations, been very fortunate to have had the chance to play with some iconic musicians.
